_comment: The command runner runs the whole Vitest suite per mutant (about 3 s). @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner 10 does not activate mutants under Vitest 5: csv.ts scored 1.4% with it, 76.6% with this. Two runs at a time with a 60 s timeout: at concurrency 4 on a 4-vCPU runner, 928 of 1,000 mutants timed out from CPU contention and counted as killed (98.8%).
